text:
Maya Patel: Heads-up: a mid-size marketplace (PilotCo) asked for a lightweight Optimize Toolkit alpha focused on mobile latency and safe quant recommendations. They want something non-intrusive to integrate.
Liam O'Connor: Key asks summarized: (1) mobile-first batching mode that keeps latency tight, (2) int8 suggestion with automatic fallback, (3) eval-based alerts that trigger when customer prompt-set quality drops.
Priya Rao: From product side: propose a scoped alpha with a heuristic recommender (not full ML model), runtime flags, and an eval webhook for alerts. Acceptance criteria: p95 mobile latency < 140ms for single-token hits, >=15% token cost reduction, and automatic fallback that keeps eval delta <= 0.03.
Liam O'Connor: Runtime notes: adaptive batching with small max_latency (50ms), prefix KV caching for repeated prefixes, and client-side batching hint (sdk_mobile_hint). Also need to instrument a "quant_fallback" event in telemetry.
DevOps-Bot: @Liam O'Connor started a quick capacity simulation: params {rps: 8 per mobile region, batch_window_ms: 50, model: rwd-7b-int8}. ETA ~12h.
Ethan Brooks: Implementation trade: expose auto-fallback by default but include per-customer opt-out via console. Telemetry must show counts and prompt examples that triggered fallback.
Maya Patel: For launch gating let's include: SDK flags, runtime mobile-adaptive mode, a heuristic quant recommendation endpoint, eval webhook + alerting, and a pilot metrics dashboard.
Priya Rao: Timeline expectation: eng can deliver a minimal alpha in 5 weeks if we prioritize the runtime and heuristic endpoints. Full ops for recommendation model will be later.
Liam O'Connor: I'll scope a minimal runtime patch: add mobile_hint, tweak batching scheduler, prefix cache toggle, emit quant_fallback events, add config to set max_latency_ms per-customer.
Maya Patel: Customer integration ask: we require a 3-day integration window to flip SDK flags and 2 weeks of traffic to gather eval signals. PilotCo agreed tentatively.
Ethan Brooks: Risks: Int8 regresses on certain prompt families. Mitigation: run eval set nightly against pilot prompt-set, auto-fallback on detected drift, and a manual rollback in console for customer.
Priya Rao: Acceptance criteria restated: mobile p95 < 140ms, token savings >=15%, quality drift <=0.03 or fallback documented.
Maya Patel: Action items: @Liam implement runtime flags (owner), @Ethan create telemetry schema + fallback event (owner), @Priya write pilot comms and acceptance criteria (owner), @Maya coordinate customer kickoff (owner).
Liam O'Connor: I'll open the runtime branch today and post a short RFC.
DevOps-Bot: Simulation queued. Will post results in this thread when done.
Priya Rao: Thanks everyone. Keeping scope narrow will help ship quickly.
